verdict.rationale: The engine runtime is MIT-licensed and open source. A permissive license structurally protects shipped games from runtime repricing, but the evidence never documents any history of the commercial plan terms or any commitment against retroactive changes. Missing for 10: documented track record of stable pricing/license terms, explicit no-retroactive-change policy for Editor/hosting plans, independent corroboration of pricing stability.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the pricing and license terms have a track record of stability — no retroactive changes that reprice games already shipped

citations.quote: PlayCanvas is an open-source game engine built on WebGL2 and WebGPU.
